title: RIGOR: Reconfigurable Electrically Actuated Testing Rig for Compressive Loading (design files, firmware and calibration data)
description:
Open-hardware design files for RIGOR, an electromechanical rig that applies, holds, steps and cycles a commanded compressive force (0–90 kg) using closed-loop control on an in-line load cell. The measurement chain meets ISO 7500-1 class 1.

Contents: bill of materials, SolidWorks CAD and drawings, KiCad PCB project and gerbers, firmware for the control board (Arduino Nano ESP32) and the touchscreen (ESP32-S3, LVGL), the calibration workbook and data, the MATLAB analysis script, and assembly, wiring, operation and safety documentation.

Licences per part: hardware CERN-OHL-P-2.0, firmware and scripts MIT, documentation and data CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE.md).
